question: A chemical indicator (autoclave tape) that changes colour confirms that the instruments inside the pack have been sterilised.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is false. Autoclave tape (external chemical indicator) changes colour on exposure to heat but only confirms the pack passed through a sterilizer — it does not confirm that conditions adequate for sterilization were achieved inside. Biological indicators with resistant spores are needed to confirm sterilization.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — this is false. External chemical indicators confirm only that the pack was exposed to a sterilizer cycle. They do NOT confirm that sterilising conditions (temperature, pressure, time) were met inside the pack. Biological indicators (spore tests) are the gold standard for confirming sterilization.
